detail.longDescription: I am using Great Expectations (GE) in a Databricks environment and I am trying to implement a custom SQL validation rule. My current custom SQL query looks like this: Copyquery = """ SELECT * FROM {batch} WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM {batch} ) GE replaces {batch} with the batch/table that is currently being validated. For example, if my batch is batch_1, GE effectively executes something similar to: SELECT * FROM batch_1 WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM batch_1 ) My requirement I need to work with two different inputs/batches in the same validation. Batch 1 → source data Batch 2 → reference/comparison data. Conceptually, I would like to execute something like SELECT * FROM batch_1 WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM batch_2 ) However, I currently see {batch} as representing only the batch associated with the current validation. I am not clear on how GE supports passing a second batch into the same Custom SQL expectation/query. Environment Great Expectations Databricks Spark/SQL Custom SQL validation Multiple Delta/Spark tables
